title: Serein Distribution Payload Manifest
description: Enumerates exactly which repository-derived files are embedded onto Serein distribution media, with a per-file sha256 so the inspector can prove payload integrity without trusting the build host. Never a full worktree copy - see docs/distribution/payload.md for the allowlist this manifest is built from.

source_commit.description: Full git commit sha the payload was assembled from.

generated_from.description: Top-level allowlisted source roots this payload was built from (e.g. 'src/serein', 'hardware/profiles').

path.description: Payload-relative path (POSIX separators), never an absolute host path.
